name: ao-setup
description: >- First run of Orchestrator Bot: find every computer that runs AO, save them as AO hosts, add a remote AO host that has no Grok Bot desktop app, and turn on optional routines. On a computer without Orchestrator.inc it helps install it and get it ready: a coding agent, a first project and the first orchestrator. Use on the first chat, when memory has no "AO hosts" note, or when the user says "set up AO", "add a host", "add remote host", "check my AO setup" or "install Orchestrator".
author: Untrivial-ai
